newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil judge delays ruling on B Band injunction.
newsitem.headline: Brazil judge delays ruling on B Band injunction.

text.p: A Brazilian judge mulling an injunction that would suspend the government's B Band cellular telephone concession program will not announce his decision before Monday at the earliest, a court official said.
"It won't be until Monday at the earliest," the official said. "Apparently a more urgent case has come in."
The judge has been asked by a trade union to suspend the government's plan to tender out B Band concessions on the grounds that elements of the program are unconstitutional.
The case is separate from a challenge to the concessions program in Brazil's Supreme Federal Tribunal lodged by left-wing opposition parties.
The tribunal decided Thursday to put that case on hold for 10 days to request further information on the B Band tenders.

The government has invited private groups to bid by April 7 for tenders to run 10 concessions to run regional cellphone services over 15 years, in the first stage of Brazil's telecommunications privatization.
